name: telemetry-exporter
description: Telemetry Exporter + Excel tools (report merger, IMEI splitter, timestamp matcher, date filter, day shift, last IMEI extractor)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
